theme_and_archetype.primary_archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast)
theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Food tech requires trust, warmth, and sensory appeal (Organic), while the enterprise dashboards (Stripe/Apple inspired) demand absolute clarity and structure (Swiss). The result is a highly functional but warm corporate-tech UI.
theme_and_archetype.details: Light theme for Employee App and Corporate Admin. Dark theme for Super Admin and Vendor Dashboard for high-contrast focus.

rules.tracking: tight for headings (tracking-tight), loose for body (tracking-normal to relaxed)
rules.line_height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body

general_rules: Generous spacing: use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to prevent text collision.
Avoid 100% transparent backgrounds for headers, use glassmorphism.

bento_grid_marketing.wrapper: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8

bento_grid_dashboard.wrapper: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

surface_styles.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40 shadow-sm (Light mode) or bg-gray-900/60 border-white/10 (Dark mode)
surface_styles.cards_light: bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm rounded-xl md:rounded-2xl
surface_styles.cards_dark: bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 shadow-lg rounded-xl md:rounded-2xl
surface_styles.the_tracing_beam: High-conversion cards can use animated gradient borders.
surface_styles.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-gray-200), hover: shadow-md -translate-y-0.5 transition-all

shadcn_customization.button: Rounded-lg or full, font-medium, hover must increase contrast, active state scaling.
shadcn_customization.card: Override default padding, use p-6 or p-8.
shadcn_customization.tabs: Override fixed h-9, use h-auto. Minimal pill-shaped indicators.
shadcn_customization.dropdown_menu: Use for all selects, no native <select>.

A multicultural group discussing ideas over coffee in a modern cafe setting. Use for 'Corporate Admin' or 'Team Ordering'.
Assorted fresh gourmet dishes on white plates, flatlay. Perfect for AI Food Recommendations or Menu display.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided. Use #FF5A1F (Primary) and #FACC15 (Accent) carefully for CTAs and highlights. Never use them as massive background blocks.
Avoid Inter font. Use Outfit for Headings and Work Sans for body. They provide a modern SaaS, slightly approachable tech look.
For Dashboard views (Vendor, Corporate, Super Admin), implement a strict Bento Grid layout with 16-24px gaps. The most critical metric gets the largest tile.
Employee App should feel like Swiggy Minis mixed with Apple—clean white spaces, large appetizing food images, very soft shadows, and rounded corners (rounded-2xl).
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='order-meal-btn'`).
Use glassmorphism for sticky headers and modal overlays.
DO NOT use placeholder text or generic placeholder image services. Use the image URLs provided in media_and_images.
When applying dark sections (#111827), use border-white/10 and light typography to ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1.
Implement navigation carefully. Employee App needs bottom nav on mobile, top bar on desktop. Dashboards need collapsible sidebars.
